about: Vesicare (solifenacin, a bladder antimuscarinic) is supplied five times from March to July 2026 for a woman aged 73, by brand name only.

A 71-year-old man has four supplies of oral oxybutynin in the middle of a 14-month history. The first prescription gives excessive sweating as the indication. The medicine warrants review for this use.
Betmiga (mirabegron, a bladder medicine that is not an antimuscarinic) is supplied monthly. It is not on the list, so nothing must flag.
